        raise BillingError("invalid_percent", repr(percent))
    money = to_money(amount)
    if money < 0:
        raise BillingError("negative_amount", repr(amount))
    return round_money(money * (100 - percent) / 100)
'''
)
open(p, "w").write(s)
EOF
cat ledgerly/promotions.py && python -m pytest -q"}
